1879064390.name: Passage of Foes
1879064390.desc: Allows you to track the presence of nearby Orcs, trolls, giants, and evil Men or dwarves.

1879073606.name: Return to Thorin's Gate
1879073606.desc: This enables you to quickly return to Thorin's Gate. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879089862.name: Guide to East Angmar
1879089862.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to East Angmar.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879101510.name: Travel to Personal House
1879101510.desc: Return quickly to your personal home. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879102534.name: Practical Joke
1879102534.desc: Whose fault is it if the mightiest of heroes cannot take a joke?

1879104838.name: Curse of the Coward's Soul
1879104838.desc: Release hallucinogenic spores that strike fear into nearby enemies.

1879160006.name: Prized Nimble Redhorn-goat
1879160006.desc: As a great ally of the Iron Garrison Miners, one can expect access to their most well-trained and quickest goats.  This goat can move as fast as most horses.

1879201478.name: Riddle
1879201478.desc: Daze two enemies briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

1879212102.name: Potent Bird Seed
1879212102.desc: Apparently this bird seed has been mixed with Lembas making it highly desireable to birds, though it smells quite *fowl* to you! (haha!)

1879213894.name: A Snail out of its Shell (Tactical)
1879213894.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879216070.name: Improved Seeking Blade
1879216070.desc: Your next Relentless or Remorseless Strike will critically strike your foe, if used within 10 seconds. After this, your chance to critically hit with Relentless and Remorseless Strikes will increase for 10s.

1879217094.name: Coda of Fury
1879217094.desc:
A Finishing Skill that deals enormous damage to the target and restores some of your power.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Coda of Fury echoes in your target's ears, dealing additional damage after a brief delay.\n

1879230022.name: Muster in Stangard
1879230022.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Stangard in the Great River.

1879242310.name: Mearas-lore
1879242310.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879244870.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879244870.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn discipline transforms you into a fearsome adversary specialising in the joust and return nature of close mounted combat.

1879245638.name: Ameliorating Oration
1879245638.desc: A quick reflection on the power of words yields a damaging or inspiring effect to the Rune-keeper's enemies or allies.

1879250758.name: Enduring Embers
1879250758.desc:
Using your knowledge of fire and all that burns, you heave handfuls of pitch soaked embers at your target. They burn hotter and hotter over time.

When your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will deal additional damage. <rgb=#FF7700>

The effects from this skill can stack up to 3 times.</rgb>

1879251526.name: Return to Snowbourn
1879251526.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of the Sutcrofts, you're able to quickly return to Snowbourn in the Sutcrofts. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879260614.name: A Warden's Resolve
1879260614.desc: Through a steadfast demeanor and an unshakeable resolve, you inspire your allies to greatness in the face of adversity.

1879267142.name: Strength in Panic
1879267142.desc: You heal quickly while in this state of panic.

1879267910.name: Song of Unity
1879267910.desc: The Minstrel sings a song that allows them to instantly reap the benefit of two ballads and unlock their Coda

1879271750.name: Juggernaut
1879271750.desc: Block all attacks briefly, reflecting some damage back to your enemies.

1879302598.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Warden)
1879302598.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879315142.name: Snap Shot - Stealthed Ambush with Flame
1879315142.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879316038.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879316038.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline turns your focus to overpowering your foes with devastating attacks.

1879316166.name: Marsh Frog
1879316166.desc: Summons a marsh frog to keep you company.

1879360838.name: Agarnaith Snake
1879360838.desc: Brings out an Agarnaith snake to keep you company.

1879368646.name: Green Peacock
1879368646.desc: Brings out a green peacock to keep you company.

1879385158.name: Snow Not-so-grim
1879385158.desc: Brings out a snow not-so-grim to keep you company.

1879404998.name: Nafni's Speed
1879404998.desc: Nafni's ability to sprint at great speed surprised many of his Longbeard brethren.

1879447366.name: Cream Corgi
1879447366.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879453254.name: Greater Anointing of the Slick Flesh
1879453254.desc: A coating of slick mud provides protection against critical attacks and helps ease the sting of ill effects on your allies.

1879460550.name: White Puppy
1879460550.desc: Summons a friendly puppy to accompany you on your journeys.

1879483974.name: Follow Through
1879483974.desc: Brawlers have been known to inspire foolhardy acts of bravery - mostly by charging headlessly into a fray.

1879506630.name: Fire-spike
1879506630.desc: Send a spike of fire at your target, dealing damage and applying a persistent burn.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879516870.name: Pumpkin Huorn
1879516870.desc: Summons a seasonal gourd pet to accompany you on your travels.

1879522630.name: Minor Ballad - Dissonance
1879522630.desc: Boosts Tactical damage and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879528262.name: Prepared: Wisp of Flame
1879528262.desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.

conditionalEffects.description: Flame Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Ignite effect if present, up to Tier 3.
